card.name: Titles before a historical figure's name
card.fires_on: The word just before a named political or historical figure, such as a title (deputy, President, Professor), "led by", or "including", in early 20th-century history text.

modes.label: Title before a name
modes.description: A job title or rank right before a person's name in a historical account.
modes.example: In 1947<< President>> Harry Truman authorized the National Academy of Sciences

modes.label: Linking word before a leader
modes.description: Words like "led by" or "including" that introduce a named leader.

card.writes: It seems to push toward first names or surnames of people, and away from other given names such as Sue, Ned and Larry.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before the name of a historical leader, such as a title or "led by".
